newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban foreign minister not officially planning Japan visit.
newsitem.headline: Cuban foreign minister not officially planning Japan visit.

text.p: Cuban Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina has left on a two-week, four-country Asian tour, but is not officially scheduled to visit Japan, the Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.

Japan's news agency Jiji Press quoted a government source in Tokyo on Wednesday as saying Robaina was expected to visit Tokyo and to exchange views on the Lima hostage crisis with his counterpart, Yukihiko Ikeda, and other Japanese government officials on April 17.

However, Cuban Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Marianela Ferriol, speaking at a regular weekly news briefing, said Robaina's official itinerary was to visit Singapore, India, Malaysia and Brunei. She said the minister left Havana on Wednesday evening and is due back in mid-April.
